en.hubeali: From him, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Raib, from Al Halby, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws, said, ‘I asked himasws, ‘Should the man recite during hisasws Salāt and his clothes are upon his mouth?’ Heasws said: ‘There is no problem with that, when his ears can hear his own humming’.
en.sarwar: 15. It is a narration from him (narrator of previous Hadith) by Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from ibn Mahbub from ibn Ri’ab from al- Halabiy who has said the following:
“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ’Can one recite in Salah (prayer) with his clothes on his mouth? He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not harmful if his ears can hear his humming.’”
